title: Boolean loop replay machine
statement: Consider a Turing machine with one work tape, Boolean symbols, and a single state. On every transition it leaves the input head in place and makes no change or movement on the work tape. If the scanned work-tape cell contains a Boolean value, the machine outputs that value and remains in its state; if the cell is blank, it outputs nothing and halts.
